name: com.yatechstudio.navigationsystem
description: A professional routing and navigation framework for Unity. Decoupled scene-based pages, Addressable windows and popups, nested sub-panel history, auth guards and automatic Addressable lifecycle management, with Clean Architecture layering and VContainer-friendly dependency injection.

samples.description: Complete navigation demo: MainMenu + Shop scenes, page/popup/window route types, auth-guard flow, mock bridges, and VContainer DI bootstrap.
